costs: 0.3% per side (0.6% round trip) — documented separately
position_size: 20% per trade (no overlapping positions per ticker)
metrics: PF, WR, Net PnL (sum of returns), Max DD (equity curve), Avg R, Expectancy
pnl_definition: Sum of individual trade returns (%) — NOT compounded portfolio return
dd_definition: Peak-to-trough on equity curve with 20% position size per trade
overlap_handling: Trades counted individually (not portfolio-level) — identified as limitation
